channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Yemen’s Houthis attack Aden airport; Saudi forces down missile near Riyadh
item.description: Yemeni government says one of the missiles hit Aden airport's runway minutes before a flight from Cairo was due to land.

item.title: Has Russia’s fuel crisis given Iranian oil an opening in Central Asia?
item.description: Iran's oil exports have struggled amid a US blockade. A Russian energy crisis because of Ukrainian attacks could help.

item.title: At least two killed in Kyiv as Russia launches ‘massive’ attack on Ukraine
item.description: Russia’s Defence Ministry says its forces carried out a 'massive strike' on Kyiv and other Ukrainian regions.

item.title: Oman evacuates injured crew from attacked tanker in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: India's Foreign Ministry says 11 out of 12 injured crew members on board the On Peace are Indian nationals.

item.title: Two Houthi missiles target Yemen’s Aden International Airport
item.description: Explosions near Aden International Airport after Yemen’s Saudi-backed gov't said two missiles were fired by the Houthis.

item.title: Residents of kibbutz destroyed in 7 October Hamas-led attacks grapple with how to rebuild
item.description: Three years on from the attack on Nir Oz, in which 47 people were killed and 76 taken hostage, some survivors have returned to live there.

item.title: White House defends Trump comment to let Iran 'take out' LA and San Diego
item.description: Gavin Newsom called the remarks "deranged", but the White House said Trump was warning of the risk of a nuclear Iran.
